coordinate_system: normalized page coordinates from 0.0 to 1.0, origin at top-left
layout_rules: Use the exact approved dialogue and narration records after artwork generation.
Dialogue-heavy pages define panel and balloon geometry before generation.
A full-page immersive scene uses only the actual locked page lettering; it is not rejected for failing an arbitrary generic top-mask rule.
Do not shrink a major character or manifestation solely to manufacture blank space.
Inspect the final composed page at actual reading size.

text.exact_text: What remains of a kingdom when every gate still stands, every throne is occupied—and yet none of its rightful guardians can return?

panel.crop_priority: complete Devī silhouette and distinguishable radiance streams

text.exact_text: Śiva's radiance forms her face; Yama's her hair; Viṣṇu's her arms; the Moon's her breast; Indra's her waist; Varuṇa's her thighs and legs; Earth's her hips; Brahmā's her feet; sunlight her toes; the Vasus her fingers; Kubera her nose; Prajāpati her teeth; Agni her eyes; the twilights her brows; Vāyu her ears.
text.minimum_reading_size_check: REQUIRED; split into a designed source inset if the exact text does not fit

panel.crop_priority: opposing arrow vectors and both shooters

text.exact_text: Devī answers Cikṣura's arrows, then his horses, driver, bow and banner fall from the fight.

panel.crop_priority: neck pin, half-emergence, trident contact and sword-at-neck action

text.exact_text: Devī leaps, pins his neck, strikes with the trident and beheads the half-emerged Asura without graphic emphasis.
